system.description:
Sprained Leg — simple critical injury; leg.

Untreated: SPD, Dodge/Escape, and Athletics −2.

Stabilized: SPD, Dodge/Escape, and Athletics −1.

Treated: SPD −1.

Healed: The wound has healed. Its temporary penalties no longer apply.

Care: Stabilize with one First Aid check at DC 12; Healing Hands can perform First Aid tasks. Medical treatment takes 2 rounds followed by one Healing Hands check at DC 12. Magical treatment requires 4 successful healing-spell uses at Spell Casting DC 14; these uses do not restore HP.

Recovery: Stabilization does not start healing. After medical or magical treatment, use BODY and severity in the Critical Healing table (p.174) for the recovery time. Temporary treated penalties end when that recovery is complete.

Record successful magical treatment manually. Spellcasting and its resource costs are not automated by this wound card.

Source: The Witcher Core Rulebook v1.35, p.158; stabilization p.162; treatment and recovery pp.173–174. Core Errata 2022 applies.

system.description:
Dismembered Leg — deadly critical injury; leg.

Untreated: The leg is lost or permanently unusable. SPD, Dodge/Escape, and Athletics are quartered. Bleeding begins.

Stabilized: SPD, Dodge/Escape, and Athletics remain quartered. Wound-induced bleeding ends.

Treated: The missing or unusable leg can be replaced with a prosthesis. Without a prosthesis, the quartered SPD, Dodge/Escape, and Athletics remain.

Healed: Permanent consequence: the leg remains missing or unusable. SPD, Dodge/Escape, and Athletics remain quartered unless a prosthesis changes these penalties.

Care: Stabilize with one First Aid check at DC 18; Healing Hands can perform First Aid tasks. Medical treatment takes 8 rounds followed by one Healing Hands check at DC 18. Magical treatment requires 10 successful healing-spell uses at Spell Casting DC 20; these uses do not restore HP.

Recovery: The book gives no recovery duration for Deadly wounds. Permanent consequences remain after treatment or a healed label.

Record successful magical treatment manually. Spellcasting and its resource costs are not automated by this wound card.

Core p.174 gives no healing duration for Deadly wounds. A healed label does not restore the leg. Prostheses and their training rules are on pp.160 and 174.

Heart Damage — deadly critical injury; torso.

Untreated: Make an immediate Death save. If the character survives, Stamina, SPD, and BODY are quartered and bleeding begins.

Stabilized: Stamina, SPD, and BODY are halved. Wound-induced bleeding ends.

Treated: Whenever the character is bleeding, bleeding damage increases by 2 per round, permanently.

Healed: Permanent consequence: whenever the character is bleeding, bleeding damage increases by 2 per round.

Care: Stabilize with one First Aid check at DC 18; Healing Hands can perform First Aid tasks. Medical treatment takes 8 rounds followed by one Healing Hands check at DC 18. Magical treatment requires 10 successful healing-spell uses at Spell Casting DC 20; these uses do not restore HP.

Recovery: The book gives no recovery duration for Deadly wounds. Permanent consequences remain after treatment or a healed label.

Record successful magical treatment manually. Spellcasting and its resource costs are not automated by this wound card.

The initial Death save occurs once when the injury is acquired. The permanent penalty does not cause bleeding on its own; it increases damage while bleeding. This follows the p.160 correction in Core Errata 2022. Core p.174 gives no healing duration for Deadly wounds.

Source: The Witcher Core Rulebook v1.35, p.160; stabilization p.162; treatment and recovery pp.173–174. Core Errata 2022 applies.

Separated Spine / Decapitated — deadly critical injury; head.

Untreated: The character dies immediately.

Stabilized: This fatal injury cannot be stabilized.

Treated: This fatal injury cannot be treated.

Healed: This fatal injury cannot heal. Changing its record does not revive the character.

Care: Fatal injury: stabilization, treatment, and healing are unavailable.

Recovery: No recovery clock applies.

No stabilization, medical treatment, magical treatment, or recovery clock is available for this fatal injury.

Source: The Witcher Core Rulebook v1.35, p.160; stabilization p.162; treatment and recovery pp.173–174. Core Errata 2022 applies.
